name: RapidTriage core forensics #61-#70 internal fixture validation

datasets.name: #61 advanced search fixture assertions

required_assertions: Search output preserves query mode/options, fuzzy/stem/regex support, proximity metadata, hit pointers, per-hit advanced_search_hit_manifest rows, top-level advanced_search_query_hit_manifest, query/hash/head hashes, source locators, advanced_search_profile query validation, regex validity warnings, web mode/fuzzy/proximity controls, verification warnings, trusted query-hit diff status, and #61 core_accuracy_gates.

Advanced search reportability decisions block source-proof claims until source rows are hash verified, regex/fuzzy/proximity false-positive review is documented, and a trusted query-hit manifest diff passes.

datasets.notes: Internal fixture pass; broad relevance/false-positive corpus, full browser query-builder validation, and external trusted query-hit manifest remain commercial blockers.

datasets.name: #62 keyword pack fixture assertions

required_assertions: Keyword-pack outputs preserve built-in inventory, custom JSON support, deduplicated expansion, pack provenance, per-pack keyword-pack-manifest, library keyword-pack-library-manifest, selection keyword-pack-selection-manifest, keyword row hashes, expansion head hashes, manifest hashes, API search keyword_pack_selection_profile, web built-in pack selection controls, trusted expansion diff status, case-specific warnings, and #62 core_accuracy_gates.
Keyword-pack reportability decisions block release-reviewed pack claims until signed/versioned packs, case edits, language/domain corpus validation, and a trusted expansion manifest diff exist.

datasets.notes: Internal fixture pass; signed pack library, trusted pack manifest diff, per-case editing UI, and language/domain corpus validation remain blockers.

datasets.name: #63 IOC/TI fixture assertions

required_assertions: Indicator output preserves source links, local rule matches, offline feed provenance with feed hash/size, feed/indicator/enrichment manifests, feed row hashes, indicator row hashes, API/web local enrichment review package fields, match mode, local-only warning, trusted IOC/TI diff status, and #63 core_accuracy_gates.
IOC/TI reportability decisions block live TI verdict claims until signed feed provenance, STIX/TAXII/provider validation, confidence decay, trusted enrichment diff, and API governance exist.

datasets.notes: Internal fixture pass; signed/STIX/TAXII feed validation and trusted enrichment oracle remain blockers.

datasets.name: #64 citation manager fixture assertions

required_assertions: Case DB report export preserves review/source citation IDs, copy-safe citation strings, citation row hashes, source-viewer locators, source references, source-hash/parser-version coverage profile, report-citation-index-manifest, citation rows head hash, citation counts, report-use warnings, trusted citation-index diff status, and #64 core_accuracy_gates.

Citation manager reportability decisions block court exhibit claims until review/source citations, source hashes, parser versions, exhibit numbering, trusted citation manifest diff, manifests, and reviewer sign-off exist.

datasets.notes: Internal fixture pass; exhibit numbering, trusted citation manifest diff, and jurisdiction-specific packaging remain blockers.

datasets.name: #65 evidence history fixture assertions

required_assertions: Review history preserves version rows, target IDs, changed fields, previous/current state, report inclusion changes, history-viewer locators, per-row hashes, export-time history hash chain/head hash, evidence-selection-history-manifest, database append-only update/delete guards, multi-user warning, trusted history diff status, and #65 core_accuracy_gates.
Evidence history reportability decisions block multi-user signed-history claims until signed selection history, trusted history manifest diff, and conflict handling exist.

datasets.notes: Internal fixture pass; signed multi-user history, trusted history oracle, and conflict handling remain blockers.

datasets.name: #66 benchmark fixture assertions

required_assertions: Benchmark output preserves scale matrix, benchmark-scale-proof-manifest with covered/missing 100k/1M/10M targets, ingest/search metrics, raw latency samples, environment profile, release-threshold guardrail profile, metric/environment/threshold hashes, memory/output size, run-summary link, hardware-scale warning, trusted threshold diff status, #66 core_accuracy_gates, and #66 commercial_uplift_evidence.

Benchmark reportability decisions block published scale-proof claims until hardware, OS, dependency, evidence-size, wall-time, memory, p95, trusted threshold manifest, and independent reproduction evidence exists.

datasets.notes: Internal fixture pass; published hardware matrix and trusted threshold manifest remain required.

datasets.name: #67 stress-plan fixture assertions

required_assertions: Stress-plan output preserves TB scenarios, resource caps, failure thresholds, evidence bundle requirements, per-scenario run-log templates, telemetry/evidence capture profile, real-hardware warning, trusted run-log diff status, #67 core_accuracy_gates, and #67 commercial_uplift_evidence.
Stress-plan reportability decisions block executed TB-validation claims until actual 1TB-10TB hardware runs, trusted run-log manifests, bottleneck traces, and independent reproduction logs exist.

datasets.notes: Internal fixture pass; actual 1TB-10TB hardware runs and trusted run-log manifests remain required.

datasets.name: #68 incremental indexing fixture assertions

required_assertions: Run fingerprint output preserves fingerprint, path/size/mtime metadata, bounded per-file SHA-256 hashes, incremental reuse plan counts, changed-source reuse behavior, truncation disclosure, trusted reuse diff status, limitation warning, #68 core_accuracy_gates, and #68 commercial_uplift_evidence.

Incremental indexing reportability decisions block content-hash-complete claims until full large-file delta reuse, row-level stage reuse, trusted reuse manifests, and large-case replay validation exist.

datasets.notes: Internal fixture pass; full large-file content-hash delta reindexing and trusted reuse manifests remain blockers.

datasets.name: #69 background job queue fixture assertions

required_assertions: Job payloads preserve status, step progress, state persistence, append-intent transition logs, transition head hashes, cancel/retry state, local-threadpool limitation, trusted transition-log diff status, #69 core_accuracy_gates, and #69 commercial_uplift_evidence.

Job queue reportability decisions block distributed parser-scheduler claims until distributed worker, externally trusted transition logs, parser-level progress, resource telemetry, cancellation, and retry validation under load exists.

datasets.notes: Internal fixture pass; distributed workers, trusted transition logs, and parser-level progress telemetry remain blockers.

datasets.name: #70 checkpoint/resume fixture assertions

required_assertions: Run checkpoint output preserves stage checkpoints, output path/size, reused flags, row hashes, checkpoint integrity head hash, resume summary, partial-stage warning, trusted checkpoint diff status, #70 core_accuracy_gates, and #70 commercial_uplift_evidence.
Checkpoint reportability decisions block mid-parser-complete resume claims until failed-stage and mid-parser resume are validated against trusted manifests across long-running corpora.

datasets.notes: Internal fixture pass; mid-parser checkpointing, trusted checkpoint manifests, and failed-stage resume remain blockers.
